turns.content: Can you draft a schedule template for the workshop?

Here is a template:

- [Time] - [Session title]
- [Time] - [Break]
- [Time] - [Session title]
- [Speaker]: [Bio]

Fill in each slot when the agenda is final.
And a vocabulary list for the onboarding doc?

- [noun] Sprint: a fixed work period
- [verb] Ship: release to users
- [informal] Dogfood: use your own product
